As a consequence, many properties of the hyperbolic functions follow immediately from the corresponding properties of the trigonometric functions.

Periodicity and Zeros

ⓘ
Keywords:
analytic properties, hyperbolic functions, periodicity, poles, trigonometric functions, zeros
See also:
Annotations for §4.28 and Ch.4

The functions sinh⁡z and cosh⁡z have period 2⁢π⁢i, and tanh⁡z has period π⁢i. The zeros of sinh⁡z and cosh⁡z are z=i⁢k⁢π and z=i⁢(k+12)⁢π, respectively, k∈ℤ.
